headline: Apple ordered to pay $5.7 billion in haptic patent verdict
summary: A federal jury in San Diego awarded Taction over $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed two of its haptic feedback patents, covering vibration-based tactile transducer technology. Apple is reportedly looking to appeal the verdict.
